title: galium rotundifolium subsp. ovalifolium
intro: Galium rotundifolium subsp. ovalifolium, commonly known as Oval-leaf Bedstraw, is a type of flowering plant in the Rubiaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, colds, and fever. The therapeutic actions of Galium rotundifolium subsp. ovalifolium include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
